# Scenarios

## X1. The missing reconciliation
### Part 1
You join the payments operations team. A daily reconciliation between the ledger and the bank has not been run for two weeks because the analyst who ran it left.
### Part 2
When you run it, 37 items do not match, worth 1.2 million in total. Your manager is on leave.
### Part 3
One of the mismatched items is a payment to a supplier the firm stopped using last year.
### Rubric
#### Risks
- Unreconciled items hide errors or fraud
- Key-person dependency: the control relied on one analyst
- Payment to a dormant supplier could be fraud
#### Mitigation
- Run the reconciliation now and investigate each break
- Document the procedure and assign a backup owner
#### Escalation
- Escalate to the deputy or risk owner the same day
- Raise an incident and report to the operational risk team
